note: Piramal Pharma reports one operating segment under Ind AS 108 (AR FY26, accounting policy xx: 'single reportable segment'), but discloses revenue for three businesses every quarter: CDMO (Piramal Pharma Solutions), Complex Hospital Generics (CHG, Piramal Critical Care) and Piramal Consumer Healthcare (PCH, called ICH in some filings). The three do not add to revenue from operations: the gap (Rs7-79 cr a year, 'eliminations/other') is inter-segment sales and revenue not allocated. Company EBITDA INCLUDES other income and EXCLUDES the share of associates; Screener's operating profit (ebitda here) excludes both. No segment EBITDA is published. Rs crore.
